My recommendation

Best all-around pick: Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro. The supplied results give it the clearest combination of price, ANC technology, and premium features. The advertised discount code AFSC20 was last tested on October 22, 2026, and is listed as expiring December 31, 2026.

Best alternative to investigate: EarFun Air Pro 4. The review reports strong measured noise reduction, though the headline 50 dB figure is a manufacturer claim.

Best for longer listening sessions: Sony WF-C710N, based on its listed battery life of 8.5 hours with ANC.

One caveat: the supplied sources use different testing methods, so their ANC scores and noise-reduction claims aren't directly comparable. Prices and availability may also change.
